defects_found_and_fixed.found_by: this exploration, first execution against the batch-C driver
defects_found_and_fixed.description: ConnectionDriver::poll latched eof_applied=true even when the core refused the TransportEof with its NON-FATAL backpressure code (event queue congested), permanently losing the EOF: the connection stayed in Closing forever and no terminal was ever delivered
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the EOF now stays latched on a non-fatal refusal and is retried on the next quiescent turn after outputs drain; fatal refusals still surface as a Failure output and latch
defects_found_and_fixed.red_evidence: both regression tests were executed against the pre-fix driver (fix stashed) and their failures were read; both pass with the fix restored
